dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: Her loafer skids on the polished floor of the station underpass.
Aoi clutches the paper packet in her arms — the orientation forms she went back home to retrieve after leaving them on the kitchen table.
She cuts around the last blind corner toward the school gate.
And slams straight into someone coming the other way.
Ah—!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: The packet bursts open. Papers flutter across the pavement like white birds.
Watch it.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: The voice is low and clipped. A tall boy in a different blazer steadies himself, one hand still on the strap of a duffel bag.
I-I'm so sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: I wasn't looking ahead.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Clearly.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Heat rushes to her face. She drops to her knees and starts gathering the scattered sheets with trembling fingers.
My forms... oh no...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: A shadow falls across the papers. The boy crouches too, quicker than his tone suggested.
Hold still. The wind's taking them.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: He pins one page with his palm, catches another against his knee, and hands her a bent photograph.
Th-thank you.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: You don't have to—
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: If these are your entrance forms, you kind of need them.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: She blinks. On top of the stack in his hand is the school crest and her name, written in careful ink.
You saw that?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Hard not to.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: He gathers the last sheet, then glances toward the front gate beyond the hedge.
We're both late now.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Both...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Transfer student. First day.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: He lifts the duffel a little, as if that explains the hurried look, the unfamiliar uniform, the map sticking from his pocket.
Oh.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: For a second, her embarrassment loosens. She isn't the only one off-balance this morning.
Then... we're in trouble together.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: The corner of his mouth moves. Not quite a smile, but close.
Don't say that so calmly.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: The warning bell rings from the main building.
Ah— the bell...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Can you run?
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: I can try.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: serious_expressionless

dialogue.text: They break into a run through the gate, side by side for three breathless seconds — until a teacher steps into their path.
You two. Stop right there.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi freezes so fast she almost drops the forms again.
S-sorry...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Name and class?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi Sakamoto. First year, Class Three.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: serious_expressionless

dialogue.text: Her voice comes out small, but steady enough.
Kirishima Ren. Transfer. I was heading to the office.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: The teacher's eyes narrow at the two of them, then at the papers in Aoi's arms.
First day, and already making an impression.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi's stomach sinks.
It's my fault.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: I forgot my forms and ran back home for them.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Then I turned the corner too fast.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Beside her, Ren shifts as if to object, but she keeps her eyes lowered and finishes anyway.
...At least you're honest.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Get to class, Aoi. And you, Kirishima, come with me to the office.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Relief arrives so suddenly it almost makes her knees weak.
Yes, sir.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: serious_expressionless

dialogue.text: She turns, then hesitates. Ren is already adjusting his bag, expression unreadable.
Um... Kirishima-senpai?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: What.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Thank you. For helping me.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: He looks at her for a brief, quiet beat.
Next time, look where you're going, Sakamoto.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: ...I will.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: As she hurries toward the first-year hall, cheeks still warm, she finds herself holding one bent photograph a little more carefully than the rest.
